key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F117A:0:08A4

description: Stores a passed value in a slot of the current task record, conditionally runs cleanup steps through library calls that close files and libraries, free memory and reply to a message, and returns the stored value.

description: Looks up a stream record for a handle and returns minus one if it is missing; otherwise it flushes when a flag bit is set, forwards the write to an unnamed routine with the record's field and the given arguments, and returns minus one when an error flag is set.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0298
name: emit_string_into_buffer
description: Emits each character of a string: while a remaining-space counter is positive it stores the character into a buffer, otherwise it passes the character to an unnamed routine, and it returns the number of characters processed.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0300
name: format_text_with_conversions
description: Walks a format string, copying literal characters to an output sink and expanding conversion specifiers: decimal values, strings, and eight-digit values rendered through a digit table, and returns the total number of characters produced.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0438

description: Parses one printf-style conversion: reads flag characters, width and precision (which may come from the arguments) and size modifiers, then formats a character, decimal, string, eight-digit or unsigned value with padding and sends it through a callback. It returns the position after the specifier, or zero for an unsupported conversion.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0836

description: Walks a format string and passes each literal character to a callback. A percent sign either produces a single percent for a doubled percent or starts a conversion that is parsed by an unnamed routine; the routine returns when the string ends.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0890

description: Splits a command string into up to 32 argument pointers, honoring quotes and asterisk escapes for newline and escape characters, then opens the input and output streams, falling back to a default console window specification when no argument is given.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0B04

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0B16

description: Returns zero when the buffer pointer is past its limit; otherwise it reads a character through an unnamed routine and converts lowercase letters to uppercase.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0B28

description: If the structure's pointer is null or a flag bit is set, allocates a new buffer from a stored list head and sets its pointers and flags; it returns minus one when allocation fails and zero otherwise.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0B84
name: write_char_with_newline_mapping
description: Writes one character to an output buffer, translating a newline into a carriage return and line feed pair, updating counters and flags, and flushing through an unnamed routine when the buffer fills; it returns the character written or minus one on error.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0E14

description: Walks a table of slot records from the last to the first, calling an unnamed routine with each slot's value that is enabled and does not have a flag bit set, then calls an unnamed routine with the parameter.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0E70

description: Reads a character through an unnamed routine, converts a lowercase letter to uppercase and returns it.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0E8C

description: Converts a lowercase letter to uppercase and returns the value unchanged for other characters.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0EA4

description: Converts each byte of a zero-terminated string to uppercase in place, using a flag table to decide which characters are lowercase letters, and returns the string pointer.

description: Compares two strings up to a count, folding each character to uppercase, and returns the first difference, one if only the first string is longer, minus one if only the second is longer, or zero when they are equal.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0F54
name: append_string_bounded
description: Finds the end of the destination text, appends at most the count passed in the third argument characters of the source, terminates the result and returns the destination pointer.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0FAC
name: compare_strings_case_insensitive
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte after folding lowercase letters to uppercase, returning the difference of the first mismatching characters or zero when they match.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:0FE8
name: append_string_unbounded
description: Finds the end of the destination text and copies the source text after it, including its terminator, then returns the destination pointer.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:1000
name: format_decimal_number
description: Converts a value to decimal digits by repeatedly calling an unnamed routine, stores them in a temporary buffer, copies them back in reverse order into the output, zero-terminates it and returns the length.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:F1copy:0:1030

description: Converts a value to octal digits, least significant first, into a temporary buffer, copies them into the output in order, zero-terminates it and returns the length.
